scaleContract.meshScaleFactor: per-model, from models_report.json — the SAME factor the glb exporter baked into the mesh. Use it for emitters attached to that model so particles land on the geometry they hang off.
scaleContract.worldUnitScale: 11/600 — the ability port's distance factor (600 WC3 range = 11 GGD units). Use it for emitters spawned in world space (area art, ground effects), NOT for model-attached ones.
scaleContract.warning: the repo carries three competing WC3->GGD factors (1/36 mesh default, 11/600 distance, 1/85 in gen_ex_content.py). `raw` is the only unambiguous field; convert deliberately.
